description: An instance MO2: CurrentInstance names the folder under %LOCALAPPDATA%\ModOrganizer. base_directory moves every default directory, and the [customExecutables] entries are skipped (MO2-10 is not ported).

deviations.reason: The port replaces %BASE_DIR% in a directory value with the base directory as MO2 does, so %BASE_DIR%/mods is <base>\mods, not the drive root.
The port gives an unset skip_file_suffixes / skip_directories MO2's own defaults, .mohidden and .git, instead of CSV-parsing the str() of Python's defaults.
